subject: Reverse-charge/VAT treatment for OrbitHealth subscription — VAT ID and self-billing?
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@orbithealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: treasury@orbithealth.com
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: VAT ID + reverse-charge question for July subscription invoice

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the onboarding call. Quick tax question from our finance team: we just registered a single consolidated billing entity for OrbitHealth in Ireland and attached our Irish VAT certificate (orbit_vatid_certificate.pdf). Our legal team expects the July SaaS invoices to be handled under reverse-charge (Article 194 / B2B intra-EU supply) so we shouldn't be charged Irish VAT.

Can you confirm the steps Redwood needs to take to apply reverse-charge on the July invoice? Specifically:
- Do you need a signed self-billing mandate from us, or is the VAT certificate sufficient?
- Will Redwood reissue the invoice net of VAT if you apply RC, or should we expect a credit/reissue flow?
- Any impact on payment timing if we supply PO + signed mandate this week?

I attached the VAT cert. We prefer not to be charged VAT and then request a credit if possible. Let me know what evidence you need so we can send it over.

Best,
Alice Nguyen
Finance Manager, OrbitHealth
Attachments: orbit_vatid_certificate.pdf

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: VAT ID + reverse-charge question for July subscription invoice

Hi Alice — thanks for the certificate and the clear ask. Looping in our finance lead Ben and tax ops owner Marissa so we can handle this cleanly.

Ben / Marissa — OrbitHealth have provided an Irish VAT registration certificate and are requesting that July invoices be treated under reverse-charge (net of VAT). Their preferred path is: 1) provide PO + signed self-billing mandate, 2) receive net invoices, and 3) pay on normal terms.

My suggested operational steps (for Finance/Tax ops):
- Validate VAT ID via VIES and capture expiry/registered name (we need exact matching on name/address).
- If VIES validation passes and supplier is EU-registered, we can apply reverse-charge. However we require either a signed self-billing mandate OR a documented policy confirming self-billing acceptance for this account (audit requirement).
- If documents arrive before invoice generation cut, issue net invoice; otherwise issue a reissued net invoice and a credit for VAT.

Can you confirm the minimum acceptable signed mandate language? Also advise on expected SLA for reissue once docs are received. Alice — if you can send PO + signed mandate today, Ben estimates reissue within 48h.

Thanks — Camila
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 13:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: VAT ID + reverse-charge question for July subscription invoice

Camila / Marissa — quick update from finance ops after a VIES lookup:
- VAT number (IE3421598V) returned as VALID for "OrbitHealth Limited"; registered address matches the certificate.
- Supply is SaaS hosted by Redwood (digital service delivered to a business in EU) — reverse-charge applies for B2B intra-EU supplies.

Operational checklist (what we need from OrbitHealth):
1) Purchase Order referencing Redwood subscription and invoice period.
2) Signed self-billing mandate (template attached: self-bill-mandate-template.docx). We accept a scanned signature PDF.
3) Billing contact confirmation and remittance instructions (for our AR record).

If we receive PO + signed mandate by end of day Friday 10 Jul, finance will:
- Hold the current autogenerated invoice and issue a net (RC) invoice instead; OR
- If payment has already cleared, issue an immediate credit and reissue the net invoice.

Marissa — please flag any additional audit fields (e.g., evidence of business status) if you want to capture more than the two documents above.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: self-bill-mandate-template.docx

From: Alice Nguyen <alice@orbithealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: VAT ID + reverse-charge question for July subscription invoice

Thanks, Camila and Ben — appreciated. We will: 1) send PO this afternoon, 2) sign and return the self-billing mandate, and 3) confirm remittance details.

One ask from OrbitHealth treasury: if we supply docs today, can Redwood guarantee not to place the invoice in a payment-hold or trigger automated dunning that would affect our cashflow? We plan to pay net invoice on receipt but want to avoid any credit-control flags during the exchange.

If you can confirm that receiving the signed mandate + PO will be sufficient to avoid VAT being applied and that reissue time is ~48 hours, we will proceed immediately.

Alice Nguyen
Finance Manager, OrbitHealth
OrbitHealth — treasury@orbithealth.com
